name: Saionji Teruhiko
source:
The number one outlaw in Baramon High School.
A teacher whose outlawry has not only shocked his own students, but his coworkers as well. He is just such a rapscallion.
Has rumours of being divorced once in the past.

"Let me teach you something way more important than studying..."
